title: Crew Of Lancaster PB476, 12 Squadron RAF
memorial_details:
Small granite stone of remembrance with squadron badge at top

This memorial is placed here, on/ the 50th anniversary of the crash,/ to commemorate the crew members/ who died.
inscription: In the early hours/of March 4th, 1945/ Lancaster PB 476 (PH "Y") of No. 12 Squadron/R.A.F. Wickenby,/ crashed near this spot,/ the victim of/ a Luftwaffe intruder./ This memorial is placed here, on/ the 50th anniversary of the crash,/ to commemorate the crew members/ who died./ (names)/ IN GRATEFUL REMEMBRANCE
